title: How to Build an Admin Panel Without Code
summary: Build a fully custom admin panel without writing code — user management, data tables, CRUD operations, and role-based access. Step-by-step guide using AI in 2026.
body_markdown: Blink builds the admin panel against your existing database schema — the AI does not have "access" to your production database during development. The admin panel application connects to the database using credentials you manage. Role-based access (admin-only routes) means only authenticated admin users can run admin operations. Add row-level access controls and IP allowlisting for additional security if your data is sensitive.
